answer: The tannery yard stinks of bark and lime, and the hides hang dripping from the beams. Proof of tanner via hide cure tally — a hide the tanner cures only after 28 hides lie supple in the vat, each hide cured by the tanner himself. ivory stirs the vat with a long pole and tests the liquor with his hand. falcon lifts each hide and works the flesh side smooth with the knife. river hangs the cured hides in the loft and counts them before nightfall. A man faking this tally must cure 28 hides without one turning stiff, and the twenty-ninth still cracks when it bends.
